reasons: CS3237 and CS3231 are offered only in Semester 1, so both are placed in semester 7; ST2334 must precede CS3237, so it is placed in semester 6.
CS3227 is fixed in semester 6. CS2102 is also placed there so no semester has only a single 4 MC course, since adding filler courses is not allowed.
This meets the 8 MC minimum in semesters 6 and 7, keeps CS3237 and CS2102 apart, and leaves semester 8 empty.
